title: epicharis siargaoensis
intro: Epicharis siargaoensis, commonly known as the Siargao Epicharis, is a medicinal plant species native to the Philippines. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in the treatment of various diseases. The therapeutic actions of Epicharis siargaoensis are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which have been shown to possess antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. Research on the plant's bioactive constituents has identified compounds such as epicharisin, epicharisin B, and quercetin, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
